decisions.reason: As a burner component closely tied to the firm's established radiant-heating business, it likely requires limited extra resources and would be kept unless results clearly fall below aspiration.
Its dedicated page suggests initial commitment, but as an adjacent electric offering in a competitive segment it would be reviewed critically if early sales underperform aspirations.

The electric halogen infrared heater appears the least differentiated of the new electric products, so a likely shortfall versus aspiration would make it the first candidate for problemistic search and resource reallocation.
The industrial electric infrared hall heater fits the firm's core commercial and industrial heating competence well, making it likely to stay even if early results are still stabilising.

Despite uncertainty, the hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater has strong strategic value and an actual reference installation, so available organisational slack would likely support keeping it on the market.
